item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of diplomacy-first versus force-first behavior in Somalia, the Red Sea, the Nile, and domestic emergency governance. I did not find a separate, formal crisis-deconfliction mechanism, hotline, or written military restraint protocol. The evidence is therefore mostly rhetorical and agreement-based, not operational. Even so, the December Ankara Declaration is real de-escalation evidence, not just messaging.","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia Has No Intention of Harming Somalia in Any Way: PM Abiy","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_3975603","summary":"Abiy said Ethiopia had no intention of harming Somalia, stressed that Somalia’s peace was Ethiopia’s peace, and framed access-to-sea as a mutual-benefit issue rather than a confrontation. He also pointed to training Somali recruits as evidence against conflict intent. This is strong evidence for choosing diplomacy over force in a live crisis.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.8","1B.2"]},{"title":"Ethiopia's leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port","publisher":"Associated Press via CityNews","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/","summary":"AP reported Abiy said he had “no intention” of going to war with Somalia and described peace as mutually beneficial, while also trying to ease Nile-dam tensions. This is background/context, but it directly supports the view that the January move increased conflict risk instead of prioritizing peaceful alternatives.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia Pursues Peaceful Access to Red Sea Amid Growing Economy: PM Abiy","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-10-31","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5380659","summary":"Abiy said Ethiopia sought Red Sea access “in a peaceful manner” and that the agenda was “not about confrontation.” This is strong evidence that, once the dispute had sharpened, he publicly favored compromise and de-escalation over force.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.2","1B.8"]},{"title":"Ethiopia-Somalia Ankara Declaration by the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and the Federal Republic of Somalia","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-12-12","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.tr/etiyopya-federal-demokratik-cumhuriyeti-ve-somali-federal-cumhuriyeti-nin-ankara-bildirisi.en.mfa","summary":"The declaration says the leaders met in a cordial atmosphere, reaffirmed sovereignty and territorial integrity, and agreed to set aside disputes and move forward cooperatively. This is not a diplomacy case, but it is negative context: in domestic crisis, the government relied on forceful emergency powers rather than a clearly compromise-first posture.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.3","1B.8"]}]}
